description: This file is a Zsh completion script for Git, providing command-line autocompletion features for Git commands within Zsh shell environments.

methods.name: __gitcomp
methods.description: Provides completion options for Git commands based on current context.

methods.name: __gitcomp_direct
methods.description: Provides direct completion options for Git commands.

methods.name: __gitcomp_file_direct
methods.description: Provides filename completion options with direct append.

methods.name: __git_complete_command
methods.description: Determines if a specific Git command has a completion function.

methods.name: __git_zsh_bash_func
methods.description: Handles completion for a specific Git command via bash functions.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_common
methods.description: Provides a list of common Git commands with descriptions.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_alias
methods.description: Provides a list of Git command aliases.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_all
methods.description: Provides a list of all Git commands.

methods.name: __git_zsh_main
methods.description: Main function handling Zsh command-line completion logic for Git.

methods.name: _git
methods.description: Entry point for invoking Git command completion in Zsh.
